† [מַעֲרֶה], מַ֫עַר n.[m.] bare, naked place (hence Μαραθών, Marathon, according to LewyFremdw. 144);—
1. bare place, or space: cstr. מִמַּעֲרֵה־גָ֑בַע Ju 20:33 bare (open) space of Gebaʿ (si vera l.; but v. ii. מַעֲרָב); כְּמַעַר־אִישׁ 1 K 7:36 according to the clear space on each (plate, v. לוּחַ).
2. sf. מַעְרֵךְ Na 3:5 fig. of Nineveh (pudenda exposed in shameful punishment; cf. עֶרְוָה).
